title: Prepare
what: Read what the machine is and what it allows before anything is changed: the stock system, the boot facts, the way back.

title: Boot
what: Get an image of ours accepted by the bootloader and run, one part swapped at a time, until it is known what refuses it.

title: Console
what: A window onto the running kernel: a banner, a shell, over UART or the USB gadget.

title: Kernel
what: Our kernel builds, reaches its init and says nothing worse than it should.

title: Power
what: The PMIC, the charger and the watchdog: what keeps the machine alive and safe to leave running.

title: Userspace
what: A distribution's root boots, the network is up and the health suite runs on every boot.

title: Lab
what: What the lab needs of a machine to work on it without hands: the ways in, a try that cannot brick.
